text_block_list.text:
I've been continuing practice with Gold City,
but her record times haven't improved much lately.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Aargh, my body's totally out of sync! Even though my control is flawless during modeling gigs.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Hm, when I'm modeling...? Right,
when I'm walking the runway, I—

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
(For example... the final look of the show.
Since I'm the finale, the very first step needs to be powerful—)

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
(Overwhelm the competition with large strides.
Without hesitation, push forward, and forward...)

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: (Make the highlight turn sharp and give it everything. Keep my center of gravity in mind and hold the axis steady—)

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
...Huh, oh right. Moving my body
just like I picture it is my specialty anyway.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Then when running, maybe something like that...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Hey, Trainer. I'm pretty sure there was a running form tutorial video in the trainer's office, right?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
"Show me everything you've got!
I just thought of something I wanna try."

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
(Swing the arms more sharply...
Keep the ankles set to catch the rebound from the ground...)

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Well, once you get the image down, it's smooth sailing.
Still, I'm gonna keep refining it into my ideal form!

And so, by improving her form,
Gold City's running gained even sharper edge.
